Row.Text: Aedui, Arverni, Veneti - with fearsome trumpets and heavy swords, all the Gauls gather. The smiths have crafted the silver torques, and the druids have given their blessing. Now bold they stand, humming with fury, eager to claim all lands for their own. Come, take up the carnyx and lead them forth. The world belongs to the Gauls.
Rising above disorder, Gaul emerges the first of the three kingdoms. With guile and grace, may it become the greatest.
Gaul wants to settle near other Civs, and doesn't want their own Settlements to be closer than 6 tiles. Use the Radial Ruler tool in the Lens Toggle menu to check distances between City Centers.
